root_causes.description: Initial hip_pitch error of 0.45 rad creates steady forward pitch moment
evidence: Extended hips create backward moment → forward pitch
root_causes.fix_recommendation: Investigate and fix initialization to ensure robot starts AT equilibrium

root_causes.description: Position authority cap insufficient to cancel tau_pitch at low height
evidence: Net positive torque builds up after position cap
root_causes.fix_recommendation: Create H1 profile with continuous max_position_tau = 8.0 Nm at low_0p300

ruled_out.evidence: pitch_x_ref = 0.0 throughout, matches equilibrium_pitch_x from setup
tau_pitch sign correctly opposes pitch deviation (100% correct when pitch > 0)
tau_pitch_rate sign is correct (damping), magnitude is small but appropriate
tau_pitch not clipped, tau_pitch_raw = tau_pitch throughout
tau_pitch is proportional feedback responding to pitch_x, not causing it

recommended_fixes.name: Fix E - Initial Condition Fix
recommended_fixes.description: Investigate why hip_pitch_error is 0.45 rad at step 0. Ensure robot starts AT equilibrium.

recommended_fixes.name: Fix A - Position Cap Increase (H1 profile)
recommended_fixes.description: Create H1 profile with continuous max_position_tau = 8.0 Nm at low_0p300. Smoothly transitions between heights.

do_not_implement: G1c or stronger bias cancellation (proven to worsen outside-band)
